thread:
tara: Quick heads-up 1 PR opened to clarify isolation annotations + autoscale field names in the Dedicated provisioning quickstart. Not urgent but want a short sweep for accuracy.

paul: Drop the PR link?

tara: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/6122. Summary: inconsistent annotation keys (`isolate_on_eviction` vs `isolation_on_eviction`) in examples, autoscale references a deprecated `cooldown` object path, and the SLA phrasing needs a per-shard footnote. Also add a compact example showing behavior for multi-shard reserved pools during a shard failover.

mina: I can take the YAML and the failover paragraph. Proposed compact YAML snippet for the quickstart (to replace the old block):

```yaml
reserved_pool: analytics-team-pool
autoscale:
  policy: cpu
  threshold: 0.7
  cooldown_seconds: 240
  burst_allowed: false
labels:
  isolate_on_eviction: "true"
  preemptible: "false"
```

mina: I'll add a 2-line note under the snippet: "If a shard in a multi-shard reserved pool is taken offline, traffic is routed to remaining shards where capacity permits; new allocations may be rate-limited until rebalance completes."

docs-bot: snippet-gen: regenerated Python, TypeScript, YAML, and Terraform examples for resource `dedicated_capacity` at commit f6d2b9. Preview: https://internal/snips/6122 (internal).

legal: Quick note from Legal: please avoid absolute phrasing like "99.9% for tenant pools" in quickstart. Add a footnote: "SLA values are reported per reserved-pool-shard. Aggregate availability across multi-shard pools may vary; see SLA matrix for details." Also add a short clause: "Availability may be affected by regional maintenance windows."

sahil: I'll add a tiny migration note under the Quickstart titled "Fields that changed" with exact mappings: `isolation_on_eviction -> isolate_on_eviction`, `reservedPool -> reserved_pool`, `provision_capacity -> create_capacity`, `cooldown -> cooldown_seconds`. Also adding a one-line TF provider v2 example: 

```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_capacity" "example" {
  reserved_pool = "analytics-team-pool"
  labels = {
    isolate_on_eviction = "true"
  }
}
```

tara: Plan: mina -> update YAML + failover paragraph; sahil -> migration bullets + TF snippet; legal -> final footnote wording to paste in; docs-bot already regenerated snippets. I'll assemble and open an aggregated PR update, tag eng-platform and docs reviewers. Target: merge by EOD next Tuesday unless anything major shows up. Thanks! :thumbsup:
